# How much should you charge for this embroidery job?

> Price an embroidery job from your own machine time and costs: per-piece price that hits your target margin, quantity breaks, stitch-count sensitivity, and whether a per-1000-stitches rule loses money. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/embroidery-shop-quote-calculator/)
